title: Operations, Reliability, Run Inspection, And Usage Full React Parity

specify.notes: Created the active Spec 044 specification from the generated roadmap prompt. Scope covers React parity and Jinja removal for operations console, reliability controls, run inspection, replay/lineage/timeline, usage analytics, usage export detail, old direct links, deletion evidence, and redaction-safe QA.

auto_clarifications: React operations owns the primary triage surface; old operations, reliability, run inspection, and usage browser URLs redirect to React or safe non-Jinja problems when safe.
Reliability actions are exposed only when existing backend policy marks them safe for the active principal and tenant.
Old run replay, lineage, and detail URLs redirect to React operations run-debug panels with safe context preserved when authorized.
Timeline, logs, run events, usage events, and dead-letter lists stay bounded by backend page-size and time-window limits.
Usage export detail exposes only metadata, filter snapshots, artifact references, checksums, row counts, and audit ids.
Platform operators see platform summaries; tenant admins and auditors see tenant-scoped summaries and denied routes fail closed.
Unsafe old routes return non-Jinja safe problems or documented retirement responses without data-existence leakage.

plan.notes: Planned React-only operations, reliability, run inspection, and usage browser parity by retaining React JSON APIs, converting old browser routes to redirects or safe non-Jinja problems, deleting bounded templates only after tests, and validating with backend/frontend/performance/QA/Playwright gates.
